notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content: [p]We hope you've been enjoying Pinball Breeze!  This update includes levels and ideas that we've wanted to implement since before the game's launch.  It turns out that making good pinball tables takes a lot of work!  Our music producer has also put a lot of work into improving the mixing and overall quality of the tracks, and created a new song for the title screen to complement the chill beach vibes.[/p][p][i]Please let us know what you think of the new levels and music - we appreciate your feedback![/i][/p][h1]New Level: Rack 'Em[/h1][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/2b41a5c4abd3bb9383acb54c2834b3072e23f710.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/2dc765015d9a3179170c8a7c31edfc0a2a8d2d29.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/6bc2760a6563e503b0b69b69282c0e57e8f1d217.jpg"][/img][/carousel][list][*][p]A full set of billiard balls are racked and ready to be knocked down; can you clear the table?[/p][/*][*][p]More risk, more reward: scoops hide between the out lanes to take you to the high-scoring bonus table above[/p][/*][*][p]Switches make a return to lower the inner walls and add a re-usable safety feature to the out lanes[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]New Level: Planet Hopping[/h1][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/ff9b21f286d35c9a6c80e9913d96f6a77641ab55.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/2924e930a15e26ca2e1de9e585eab57adc811755.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/0fef05d4b102ea99a26dc1c2c99ec716baaabc75.jpg"][/img][/carousel][list][*][p]Master gravity repulsion to explore the far reaches of space[/p][/*][*][p]Utilize boosters and curves to rocket the ball in a myriad of trajectories[/p][/*][*][p]Free the exoplanets from their solar prisons[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Music Updates[/h1][list][*][p]Brand new song for the title screen[/p][/*][*][p]New music track selector on the pause menu - choose which song plays for each theme[/p][/*][*][p]Mixing improvements on all tracks[/p][/*][*][p]Alternate space theme music with a more chill vibe[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Ball sometimes not teleporting properly in 3-3[/p][/*][*][p]Graphics quality preset would not stick[/p][/*][*][p]Full-screen mode confirmation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Music audio lost after moving audio sliders to 0 and back up[/p][/*][*][p]Misaligned preview images in level select UI[/p][/*][*][p]Various other minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Music mixing adjustments
[*]Simple splash FX when ball drains on beach levels
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content: [h3][b]Patch Notes 1.1.0[/b][/h3][list][*][p]♫ [b]Music[/b] for each theme ♫[/p][/*][*][p]New level: [b]Rip Curl[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/586d4fc918be26cf0dc0cd30b7ebaecd17f00284.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted VFX and lighting in beach levels to make it easier to see features at night[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535898/f81289423d7f14fab9063b8725167f1cf39e90f0.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with Steam Deck and controller tilt input bindings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level select UI overlap issues on 16:10 screens, including on Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with Depth of Field in beach levels[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug that could allow a playing with an invalid layout[/p][/*][*][p]General performance improvements and improved video memory usage[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.5 - 4/2/2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Improved the camera's ball tracking
[*]Pulled space level cameras a little further out
[*]Bug Fix: Fixed problems with rotations of constellations in space levels
[*]Constellations less bright and distracting during game play
[*]Camera can pan farther down in 3-3 while placing features
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.4 - 4/1/2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Boundaries are a little easier to see when placing features, especially on the beach levels
[*]Bug Fix: Fixed UI overlapping the help boxes on the pause menu
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3 - 4/1/2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added a high score table to the pause screen
[*]Added a missing game tester credit
[*]Bug Fix: High score tables would sometimes show incorrect information, or show 9 entries instead of 10
[*]Bug Fix: Ball could immediately drain if you fired it fast enough from the starting cannon
[*]Added asteroid kill-zones outside of 3-1 and 3-3 to take care of any errant asteroid bits that end up on the wrong side of the playfield walls
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2 - 3/29/2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Bug Fix: [b]starfish pegs[/b] in 2-2 were not always dropping when the ball hit them
[*]Added [b]Max FPS[/b] option to graphics settings
[*]Small [b]placeable features are easier to grab[/b] now, especially when intersecting walls
[*]Made changes to help [b]prevent the ball from passing through barriers[/b] at very high speed
[*]Changed title image of the space biome to read "Celestial Clockwork"
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1 - 3/28/2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added support for controller navigation of bonus cards on the finish screen
[*]Added missing application icon
[*]Fixed live-preview for camera angle setting
[*]Improved settings menu layout, and made it more readable on small screens
[/list]
